visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a black headband and a woman with reddish-brown hair are sitting side-by-side, watching a video on a smartphone held by the man. The phone displays a woman singing in a professional recording studio with a large microphone. (2) The man begins to sing along with the phone video, opening his mouth wide and making a dramatic facial expression while holding a bright yellow rubber chicken toy in front of him. (3) Both characters burst into laughter, with the woman leaning towards the man and holding her stomach as the rubber chicken is moved around. (4) The man continues his exaggerated singing performance, closing his eyes and gesturing with his hands while the woman watches him with a mixture of amusement and disbelief. (5) The scene shifts back to a close-up of the phone video showing the original singer, then cuts back to the couple where the man is now holding a small white spherical object as if it were a microphone. (6) The woman takes the white object and tries to sing the high notes of the song, her face reddening and her eyes squinting as she strains for the pitch before collapsing into laughter, appearing out of breath. (7) A white text box appears on screen as the man takes back the microphone and sings again, while the woman looks at him with a deadpan expression. (8) At the end, the camera zooms into their faces as they look directly into the lens, and the man points at the woman while more comedic text overlays appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with clean pop production featuring a female vocalist singing high-energy lyrics. (2) A man's voice abruptly enters, singing loudly and out of tune, attempting to mimic the original singer's high notes with high vocal strain. (3) A sharp, high-pitched squeak from a rubber chicken toy punctuates the singing. (4) The singing is interrupted by bursts of boisterous laughter from both a man and a woman, creating a chaotic acoustic layer. (5) The man sings lyrics with deliberate mispronunciation (e.g., 'Google you' instead of 'Glowing'), followed by more laughter. (6) A woman's voice attempts the high-pitched melody, ending with a breathy, exhausted tone and a high-pitched giggle. (7) Towards the end, a separate female voice off-camera is heard complaining about the noise level. (8) The audio concludes with the man and woman speaking in casual Mandarin, with the man's voice sounding defensive and the woman's sounding playful.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic 'expectation vs. reality' or 'sing-along challenge' where the creators attempt to cover a difficult pop song. The humor is derived from their inability to hit the high notes, their funny mispronunciations of English lyrics, and their genuine laughter at their own failure.
